cover.title: Avery Gagliano
cover.subtitle: Piano | Debut Series
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: Her ability to inhabit every room in the immense imagination of Frédéric Chopin came as a revelation. New York Classical Review

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Pianist Avery Gagliano makes her Vivo Performing Arts debut with an audacious program showcasing her prodigious command of mood and structure: from luminous to relentless, gauzy to percussive, culminating in Schumann's all-encompassing Symphonic Etudes.
body: Celebrated as "a distinctive young talent" (International Piano), pianist Avery Gagliano's concerts offer a "distinctly narrative approach" (Miami International Piano Festival). She makes her Vivo Performing Arts debut with an audacious program that demonstrates her prodigious command of mood and structure. From the luminous to the relentless, from the gauzy to the percussive, and concluding with Schumann's all-encompassing Symphonic Etudes, Gagliano offers a program that announces her as an artist of assured command.

sections.title: Program
sections.lead: Program: Schumann Novelette Op. 21 No. 8, Fauré Ballade Op. 19, Rzewski Winnsboro Cotton Mill Blues, Kirchner Interlude II, Schumann Symphonic Etudes Op. 13.

movements: Posth. Var. I: Andante, Tempo del tema
